create_atari_preprocessing: create an AtariPreprocessing wrapper around a Gym Atari environment with frame skipping and grayscale
reset_atari_preprocessing: reset the AtariPreprocessing environment and apply random no-ops before returning the initial observation
step_atari_preprocessing: step the AtariPreprocessing environment with an action and return pooled grayscale observations
apply_random_noops: apply random no-ops at the start of an Atari episode to reduce determinism
pool_and_resize: pool two grayscale frames via max-pooling and resize to 84x84 for DQN input
